output.brief:
Imelda — store 14's shrink figures did climb (1.5% → 1.9% → 2.3%), but nothing yet shows the loss is real, and no single cause is established.

Those quarterly figures are estimates extrapolated from partial counts, accurate to about ±0.6 points a quarter. When other stores showed two rises like this, the year-end full count confirmed it only 13 times out of 27. Sales mix shift is ruled out. Self-checkout, the bus-interchange footfall and staff theft each fit part of the story, but none is shown to drive losses: logged shoplifting rose the same way chain-wide after the incident app launched in April, and the ethics-line tip, checked on camera, showed cardboard bales, not stock.

Recommendation: tell Regional Operations by 20 November to keep store 14 in the 7 December full count; skipping it would lock in an unverified number. Hold off on a guard, on pulling or fully staffing the lanes, and on any action against the stocker until the count is compared with these estimates. Then act on what it shows.

Confidence: high on keeping the count; low to moderate on any single cause.
